FULL TEXT:
UNIVERSITY INSTITUTE OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH – 160014, INDIA
Advertisement Number: 31467/UIET Dated: 1-08-2025
Advertisement for Post Doctoral Fellowship (PDF-01)
(Under Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics & IT – Phase II)
Applications are invited for one Post Doctoral Fellowship (PDF-01) in CSE/IT/ECE under the Visvesvaraya
PhD Scheme Phase II, sanctioned by Digital India Corporation (DIC), MeitY, Government of India, at UIET,
Panjab University, Chandigarh. Last Date to Apply: 18th August, 2025
Fellowship Details:
● Monthly Fellowship: ₹1,08,393
● Contingency Grant: ₹1,00,000 (on pro-rata and reimbursement basis)
● Travel Support: Up to ₹2,10,000 (requires prior approval from DIC)
● Duration: 12 months
● Academic Year: 2025–2026
Eligibility Conditions (as per official guidelines):
1. Nationality: Must be an Indian citizen.
2. Educational Qualification:
○ PhD degree from a recognized university in CSE/IT/ECE
○ First class (or equivalent) in all preceding degrees
○ Consistently good academic record
3. PhD Completion Timeline: PhD should have been awarded within the last 5 years from the closing date
of application.
4. Age Limit: Upper age limit is 40 years on the date of submission.
5. Employment Status:
○ Not in regular employment
○ May hold temporary positions, but must relinquish them upon selection
6. Institution of PhD: PhD must not have been awarded from UIET, Panjab University
7. Mentor Requirement:
○ A mentor/guide must be identified at UIET who:
■ Holds a PhD
■ Holds a regular academic/research position in CSE/ECE/IT
8. Research Proposal: Must include well-defined objectives, outcomes, and deliverables
9. Industry Preference: Preference will be given to applicants with:
○ Active industry linkage, or
○ Projects aligned with industry-relevant problems
Application Process: Interested candidates must fill the prescribed application form (attached) and upload it
through the following Google Form: https://forms.gle/sXPApGwBuC6iXRrXA
For Further Information: https://jobs.puchd.ac.in/list-jobs.php, https://uiet.puchd.ac.in/?page_id=3175
For any Queries please contact : Prof.(Dr.) Mamta Juneja, Nodal Officer, Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme Phase
II, UIET, PU visvesvaraya.uiet@gmail.com, 9878677624
